blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Longshore drift is the primary mechanism responsible for transporting coastal sediments.
Traction involves the rolling of large sediment particles along the bed.
Saltation refers to the bouncing motion of sediment particles.
Suspension carries fine particles suspended within the water column.
Solution transports minerals that have completely dissolved in the water.
Longshore Drift is frequently tested as the primary mechanism of coastal sediment transport.
Be clear on the distinction between Traction (rolling of large particles) and Saltation (bouncing movement).
Do not confuse Suspension (fine particles held in water) with Solution (dissolved minerals).
